name: consumer-local
notes: The floor the harness is designed against: 10 tools, 15 sequential calls. Thinking off — its effect is model-specific and has regressed tool use before. These reach us through the openai-compat adapter, which carries neither knob: 'off' is a declared no-op there (ADR-0008), and it is written down so the day one of them arrives over the Anthropic adapter the intent is already stated. temperature 0 stays: a small model wanders without it.
